text:
Morgan: Quick sync — want a final pass on the Hosted/Dedicated/Private landing copy before next week's launch posts. main asks: (1) benchmark narrative for socials, (2) webinar hook copy, (3) inbound form routing + UTM plan. Can people drop quick notes?

Liam: Shared a PR with updated hero lines earlier: short + benefit-led. Thinking: 'Predictable inference at production scale — hosted, reserved, or behind your firewall.' Leaning to keep hosted line first for conversion experiments.

Anya: Webinar hook idea: 'From prototype to production: shipping reliable LLM inference.' 30-min workshop format, 10-min demo (Hosted fast path), 10-min ops (Dedicated), 10-min security/compliance (Private). Would pair with a benchmark case study for the promo post.

Priya: For inbound routing — recommend separate forms per mode to get intent signals. Minimal fields: name, email, company size, use case checkbox (chat, embeddings, reranking), deployment preference radio (Hosted/Dedicated/Private). Send Hosted leads to SDR pool A, Dedicated to AE-led handoff, Private to Solutions Eng for discovery.

Liam: Love the separate forms. Also propose hidden UTM + tag mapping so we can trigger different nurture tracks. Example snippet for UTMs we plan to use: `?utm_source=launch-post&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=prod-launch&utm_content=hosted`

Morgan: Nice — Priya can you map the routing flow in the sheet? Link to routing doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/copy-routing (placeholder)

Priya: Yep mapping now. Questions: do we want a 'compare' page CTA that drives to a tri-mode matrix (hosted/dedicated/private) or should that be gated? My take: matrix public, contact/gated for Private-specific compliance checklist.

Anya: Agree. Public comparison helps early-stage buyers. For Private, call out KMS/HSM, VPC, audit logs — link to gated compliance checklist (SLA/enterprise pack).

Liam: Copy micro-adjustments: Hosted headline: "Fastest path to working LLMs" Dedicated headline: "Predictable throughput, reserved capacity" Private headline: "Deploy in your network; keep data in your control" — keep parallel structure. Use quant verbs, avoid 'best' language.

Morgan: Benchmark narrative — we need 2X elements: cost/token story and latency P95. Sam from benchmarks can provide numbers but draft social copy: 'See how X startup cut inference costs 40% using Redwood Optimize + batching — live demo in webinar.' We should have an anchor graph in the landing hero.

Anya: For webinar landing copy: short blurb + bullets: 1) real-world benchmarks, 2) live deploy demo, 3) Q&A with eng + solutions. CTA: Register (Host/Dedicated/Private interest radio).

Priya: Routing detail: map `utm_content` to tag: hosted/dedicated/private so we can auto-assign via Zapier. Add `source_page` hidden field for AB test variant id.

Marketing-bot: Reminder: scheduled social posts queue opens in 48h. Please finalize copy in the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch-assets (placeholder). Reaction :bell:

Liam: I'll push a final copy pass by EOD, focusing hero hooks + CTAs. Will attach 2 short alt headlines for A/B.

Morgan: Perfect. Owners: Liam (web copy), Anya (webinar creative & promo), Priya (routing & forms). I'll consolidate into the launch checklist and share. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Priya: One quick ask — can we add a short privacy blurb on the Private form: "We only use your info to arrange enterprise follow-up" — legal approved?

Morgan: I'll check with legal. If green, add to Private form only.

Anya: Also propose a small benchmark email snippet for registrants: subject line options: 'Redwood: Inference at production scale' or 'Cut inference cost — live demo & benchmarks'. Pick one for the send.

Liam: Leaning to the second subject for open rates. Short preheader: 'Live demos + cost breakdowns inside.'

Morgan: Cool. Final TODOs added to the sheet. Closing thread once copy PR merged.

(End of thread)
